design_philosophy.identity: The Premier Digital Ecosystem for Afro Hairstyling. Sleek, professional, and community-driven.
design_philosophy.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Jewel Luxury.
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Blend SaaS utility with Streetwear/Barber culture aesthetics.
Content is King: High-quality cuts and barber profiles are the heroes.
Density with Breathing Room: High data density for dashboards, but distinct separation.
Contrast is Key: Dark Slate backgrounds with piercing Indigo and Amber accents.

usage_rules: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and major stats.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all UI elements, inputs, and long-form text.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for transaction IDs or code-like data.
Highlights/Premium: Use 'text-amber-500' or 'border-amber-500' for TrimConnect winners and Premium plans.
Text: 'text-white' for headings, 'text-slate-400' for secondary text.

logic: Main Chart: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 lg:col-span-9 row-span-2

marketing_landing.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 p-8 md:p-12
logic: Hero: col-span-12 h-[80vh] flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
Feature Big: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 bg-slate-800 p-8 rounded-2xl
Feature Tall: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 row-span-2 bg-indigo-900/20 border border-indigo-500/30 p-8 rounded-2xl

layout_strategies.spacing_scale: Relaxed. Use gap-6 or gap-8 for dashboard sections.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 px-6 rounded-lg shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white border border-slate-700 font-medium py-3 px-6 rounded-lg transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 py-2 px-4 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.battle_cta: bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-900 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider py-4 px-8 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)] transition-all

cards.base: bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm

inputs.base: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-white placeholder-slate-500 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent p-3

navigation.sidebar_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

motion.guidelines: Smooth, professional, non-distracting. Use framer-motion for complex states.
libraries: framer-motion (Recommended for Battle voting cards and page transitions)

trim_connect_battle.vibe: E-Sports meets Hair. High energy, dark aesthetic, gold highlights.
trim_connect_battle.ui_elements: Voting cards with 'Vs' badge, Leaderboard with crown icons, Countdown timers.
trim_connect_battle.colors: Heavier use of Amber-500 and Indigo-600 gradients.

ai_simulation.ui_elements: Split screen (Before/After), Loading states with 'Scanning...' animation.
ai_simulation.colors: Cyan/Teal accents for the AI scanning effect (if compatible) or pure White glow.

marketplace.ui_elements: Product grid with 'Quick Add' buttons, Filter sidebar.
marketplace.layout: Dense grid for products, large imagery for Featured items.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds (use solid Slate-900).
DO NOT use emojis. Use Lucide icons instead.
ALWAYS tint greys with a hint of blue (Slate) to match the brand.
Ensure 3:1 contrast for all text. Amber text on Slate-900 needs checking.
instructions_to_main_agent: Start by setting up the Tailwind config with the custom colors. Create the layout shell (Sidebar + Header) first. Then build the Dashboard widgets as reusable components. Prioritize the 'Dark Mode' feel - avoid pure black, use Slate-900 and Slate-800.
